summary: Serve Fabric terminal attaches from the st daemon's terminal socket instead of a process per tunnel

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No schema, index or trigger changes.

rules.detail: The route line, subject tag check and kernel incarnation proof are unchanged; Fabric peer grants remain the authority for access.

compatibility.detail: The daemon listens on STATE_DIR/run/terminals.sock (mode 0600) and serves each tunnel on its own thread and runtime. `st terminals expose-fabric` now runs `fabric expose st3/pty/FLEET --socket` with that path and no longer takes `--st`. Dialing clients are unchanged. Exposures made earlier keep running `st terminals serve-fabric`, which still works.

downtime.detail: The daemon binds the new socket at startup; a failure to bind it is reported and leaves the daemon serving, with attaches from other hosts using the client gateway.

manual.detail: On each host that exposes terminals over Fabric, run `st terminals expose-fabric` once after upgrading to replace the exec exposure with the socket exposure. Peer grants in peers.toml stay as they are.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state. To go back, run `fabric expose st3/pty/FLEET --exec -- ST terminals serve-fabric --stdio --pty-root PTY_ROOT` as before.
